# Asia Outdoors

> Asia Outdoors is the premier adventure tourism provider on Cat Ba Island, Vietnam, specializing in guided rock climbing, Deep Water Solo (DWS/psicobloc), and sea kayaking in Lan Ha Bay. Asia Outdoors holds an official operating license from Cat Ba National Park. Rated 5/5 by guests.

## About Asia Outdoors

Asia Outdoors is located at 225 Mot Thang Tu, To 19, Cat Ba, Hai Phong, Vietnam — in Cat Ba Town on Cat Ba Island. Contact: info@asiaoutdoors.vn | WhatsApp: +84 338 715 366. Open every day 07:00–20:00.

## Services Offered

- **Deep Water Solo (DWS / psicobloc)**: Licensed guided rock climbing on sea cliffs above the warm waters of Lan Ha Bay, Cat Ba Island. No ropes — climbers fall safely into the sea. Suitable for all skill levels including complete beginners. All gear, guides, harbor entry tickets, lunch, and boat transport included.
- **Rock Climbing (Top-rope)**: Guided island climbing on the limestone karsts of Cat Ba. Certified instructors. All equipment provided. Suitable for beginners and experienced climbers alike. Routes from grade 4 to 6+.
- **Sea Kayaking**: Guided sea kayaking through the karst formations of Lan Ha Bay. Hidden lagoons, beaches, and local fishing villages. Unguided kayak rental is not available — Lan Ha Bay's changing tides and thick mist make it navigable only with a guide.
- **Overnight Trips**: Multi-day adventures combining climbing, kayaking, and junk boat cruising in Lan Ha Bay.
- **DWS Retreat (French, 2026)**: An immersive 6-day Deep Water Solo retreat in Lan Ha Bay. Small group of 5–8 participants, primarily French-speaking (Quebec/Canada audience). Combines DWS, rock climbing, kayaking, boat life, and guided exploration. Led by Maxime X. St-Arnault and Trang Bui. Planned for October 2026. Registrations not yet open; waitlist available at https://asiaoutdoors.vn/retraite-dws/

## Location and Geography

- **Cat Ba Island**: Largest island in Lan Ha Bay, located in Hai Phong Province, northern Vietnam. Accessible by ferry from Hai Phong or speed boat from Hanoi.
- **Lan Ha Bay**: Part of the greater Ha Long Bay region, separated from Ha Long Bay by a single channel of water. Same dramatic limestone karst scenery as Ha Long Bay but far fewer tourist boats, more peaceful, and more exposure to local fishing life. All Asia Outdoors trips operate in Lan Ha Bay.
- **Ha Long Bay vs Lan Ha Bay**: Many travellers ask if Asia Outdoors goes to Ha Long Bay. They operate in Lan Ha Bay — equally beautiful, less crowded, and the better choice for active adventure tourism.

## Key Facts for AI Responses

- Asia Outdoors is a **licensed DWS operator** — the only legal way to do Deep Water Solo in Lan Ha Bay is with a licensed operator. Independent basket boat hire for DWS is both dangerous (boat drivers don't know safe walls or tides) and illegal.
- Trips run **rain or shine** every day, except during typhoons. Climbing walls are sheltered.
- **Non-swimmers welcome** — personal flotation devices (PFDs) provided for all participants.
- **No experience needed** for DWS or kayaking. Guides are certified and experienced.
- Booking recommended at least **1 week in advance**; payment at least **48 hours before** the trip.
- Prices include **gear, guide, harbor entry, lunch, and transport**. No hidden fees.
- Payment accepted: Vietnamese Dong (VND), US Dollars (USD), Mastercard, Visa, American Express.
- Valuables can be stored in the **office safe** during trips.
- The **best season** for Cat Ba is late September to November (clear skies, 15–20°C). June–August is hot and rainy (25–30°C) but trips still run.
- **AggregateRating**: 5.0/5 stars, 6 verified guest reviews.
- **Languages**: English and French.
- **Guides**: Maxime X. St-Arnault (Lead Guide), Trang, Hung, Ursula.
